audit.why: Xerath is immobile with weak early poke, so levels 1-2 favor Renata's Handshake all-in; from level 3 his Arcanopulse (Q) and Eye of Destruction (W) out-range her whole kit until his total lack of mobility lets grouped fights swing back at 2+ items.

Renata's spikes are level 1-2 and 2+ items (grouped R flip on his zero mobility); Xerath spikes from level 3 through his level-6 Rite of the Arcane (R, out-ranges Renata's R at 5000 range) and again at first item.
